scope: Official-source review of the next 25 published self-hostable M–R apps with empty install-option destinations, ordered by slug. The SQL is a guarded draft only and is not applied.

selection.install_options: options=[] and every destination URL/image array empty

guard_assumptions: App changes require exact id, slug, published=true, self_hosting_status=self_hostable, and exact baseline install_docs_url, docker_url, docker_image, compose_url, deployment_methods, Docker support and Compose support.
Every install-option row must still have options=[] and all 21 URL/image arrays empty before it is populated.
New source URLs are merged with existing data_source_urls and source_urls; existing source links are preserved.
Only positive Docker, image, Compose and Helm facts verified against official sources are added. Unknown or unlisted methods are not marked unsupported.
No summary, category, eligibility, source-model or resource-estimate fields are changed.
The SQL draft is not applied to production.
